thread:
Maya (ML Eng): FYI we've started a canary for Boreal-9p int8 yesterday. Early signal: overall cost improvement looks solid but a targeted drop on our longform summarization "long-legal" slice. Need quick triage + unit-econ tradeoff for GTN.

Omar (Eval): quick numbers from the slice (N=800): fp16 ROUGE-L=0.605, int8 ROUGE-L=0.565, delta -0.04 (~6.6% rel). hallucinations up ~1.4x. latency med -30%, p95 -33%.

Priya (Infra): canary infra log sample: 
```
2024-07-02T03:12:05Z boreal9p-int8 canary node-7: seq=1536, kv_cache=true
2024-07-02T03:12:05Z kernel_select: attn=fastv3 fallback=false
2024-07-02T03:12:06Z quant_profile=per-channel, layernorm_quantized=true
```
No OOMs. Some requests hit seq>1024 path.

Maya (ML Eng): initial hypotheses: 1) per-channel int8 noise on attention scaling across long contexts, 2) layernorm quantization drift, 3) kv-cache accumulation rounding.

Omar (Eval): repro command I used: 
```bash
./run_eval.sh --model boreal-9p --quant int8 --slice long_legal --seed 17 --save errors.json
```
Example fail id=88: dropped an entity and compressed multiple paragraphs incorrectly.

Maya (ML Eng): proposed quick experiments:
- build int8 with layernorm pinned to fp16 (mixed-lnorm)
- int8 per-tensor vs per-channel comparison
- disable kv-cache for slice to test accumulation
- traffic split: route seq<=768 to int8, >768 to fp16 for 48h

Priya (Infra): I can add a runtime flag for seq-threshold routing and a model tag for mixed-lnorm. I'll also capture kernel selection traces for failing IDs.

Ethan (Product): what % of traffic is this slice and what's the rough revenue sensitivity? Need to prepare GTN brief.

Omar (Eval): slice is ~12% of total generation tokens, but accounts for ~26% of feature revenue (premium summarization). Unit savings extrapolation: fp16 unit $0.0115 per 1k tokens, int8 $0.0042 => $0.0073 saved per 1k tokens. For 50M tokens/mo in this slice full-int8 saves ~$365k/mo. If we keep 20% of that slice on fp16 for quality, net saving ~ $292k/mo.

Maya (ML Eng): product risk: if long-legal quality drops, churn risk for key accounts. We should estimate value of protecting top 10 customers versus global savings.

Ethan (Product): agreed. I'll pull MRR for top customers and estimate churn risk. For GTN I'd prefer a hybrid route if it keeps >85% of quality and preserves most cost savings.

Maya (ML Eng): early micro-test: mixed-lnorm (layernorm fp16) recovered ~0.022 ROUGE-L of the gap (int8 with mixed-lnorm -> 0.587). Not full recovery but promising.

Omar (Eval): next steps on eval: add automated slice comparison dashboard, compute token-level divergence, and schedule 150 human spot-checks on discord sample.

Priya (Infra): deployment plan: I will enable seq-gate flag for the canary and tag a mixed-lnorm model build as boreal9p-int8-mxn1. Will route seq>768 to fp16 and log selection traces.

Maya (ML Eng): timeline: seq-gated canary by tomorrow morning, collect 72h window, run mixed-lnorm build tests in parallel (48h). If mixed-lnorm recovers >=80% of ROUGE gap we consider shipping a mixed-int8 profile globally with seq-based routing.

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: boreal9p-int8-seqgate deploy starts in 25 minutes (ticket #112233).

Ethan (Product): thanks. I'll assemble a short GTN note: two options -- full int8 (max save, some quality risk) vs mixed/hybrid routing (most save, protect key long-doc users). Need estimated savings & revenue impact by EOD.

Maya (ML Eng): decision capture: run seq-gated canary + mixed-lnorm experiments. Measure: ROUGE-L, hallucination-rate, latency p95, token-econ impact. If mixed profile hits >=80% quality recovery we prefer hybrid rollout.

Omar (Eval): making the eval card and adding failing examples. Will ping once human labels on 150 samples done.

Priya (Infra): I'll dump kernel traces for fail ids and attach to the card.

Maya (ML Eng): great. thanks all. ping here with results. :white_check_mark:
